signal_cue_instantly.param: table[ $id = 'drjele_xenon_sectors_per_shipyard_count', $category = 'Xenon Pressure', $name = 'Sectors per shipyard', $mouseover = 'One shipyard per this many sectors the Xenon own or contest, rounded up. At 5 that is one per five sectors, at 1 one in every sector. 0 leaves the vanilla target, which is 4, plus 2 with Split Vendetta and 1 with Cradle of Humanity.', $type = 'slidercell', $default = 0, $args = table[$min = 0, $max = 5, $step = 1], $callback = OnSectorsPerShipyardChanged, ]

table[ $id = 'drjele_xenon_sectors_per_wharf_count', $category = 'Xenon Pressure', $name = 'Sectors per wharf', $mouseover = 'One wharf per this many sectors the Xenon own or contest, rounded up. At 5 that is one per five sectors, at 1 one in every sector. 0 leaves the vanilla target, which is 4, plus 2 with Split Vendetta and 1 with Cradle of Humanity.', $type = 'slidercell', $default = 0, $args = table[$min = 0, $max = 5, $step = 1], $callback = OnSectorsPerWharfChanged, ]

table[ $id = 'drjele_xenon_max_constructions_count', $category = 'Xenon Pressure', $name = 'Constructions in progress', $mouseover = 'How many shipyards and wharfs the Xenon may have under construction at once before they start another. Keeps their miners and energy haulers feeding a few sites instead of forty. 0 is no limit, which is vanilla.', $type = 'slidercell', $default = 0, $args = table[$min = 0, $max = 10, $step = 1], $callback = OnMaxConstructionsChanged, ]

table[ $id = 'drjele_xenon_build_chance_percent', $category = 'Xenon Pressure', $name = 'Build chance', $mouseover = 'Chance, per 1-2 minute evaluation, that the Xenon start a missing shipyard or wharf. Vanilla is 5, which makes a replacement wait 20-40 minutes on average. At 100 it starts on the next evaluation.', $type = 'slidercell', $default = 5, $args = table[$min = 1, $max = 100, $step = 1, $suffix = '%'], $callback = OnBuildChanceChanged, ]

table[ $id = 'drjele_xenon_invasion_fleet_size_percent', $category = 'Xenon Pressure', $name = 'Invasion fleet size', $mouseover = 'Scales the strength a Xenon invasion gathers before it moves on a sector, and the ceiling it may request ships up to. Vanilla is 100. Bigger fleets take longer to assemble; an invasion that cannot reach its strength within an hour gives up, so pair a high value with a high build share.', $type = 'slidercell', $default = 100, $args = table[$min = 50, $max = 300, $step = 10, $suffix = '%'], $callback = OnFleetSizeChanged, ]

table[ $id = 'drjele_xenon_invasion_build_share_percent', $category = 'Xenon Pressure', $name = 'Invasion build share', $mouseover = 'How much of each invasion group the Xenon may have newly built at their shipyards rather than pulled off patrol. Vanilla is 25. This is what turns a bigger fleet into more destroyers and fighters; new ships still count against the job quotas.', $type = 'slidercell', $default = 25, $args = table[$min = 0, $max = 100, $step = 5, $suffix = '%'], $callback = OnBuildShareChanged, ]

table[ $id = 'drjele_xenon_station_attack_groups_count', $category = 'Xenon Pressure', $name = 'Station attack groups', $mouseover = 'How many groups may be out attacking enemy stations in a Xenon or contested sector at the same time. Vanilla is 2 at their aggression.', $type = 'slidercell', $default = 2, $args = table[$min = 1, $max = 6, $step = 1], $callback = OnStationAttackGroupsChanged, ]

table[ $id = 'drjele_xenon_long_range_raids_toggle', $category = 'Xenon Pressure', $name = 'Long range raids', $mouseover = 'Lets the Xenon send expeditions against sectors of every faction, not only their gate neighbours. Vanilla is off. At most two expeditions run at once; they take two hours to gather, stay an hour, build nothing and come home.', $type = 'button', $default = 0, $callback = OnLongRangeRaidsChanged, ]

table[ $id = 'drjele_xenon_miner_behaviour_mode', $category = 'Xenon Pressure', $name = 'Miner behaviour', $mouseover = 'What a Xenon miner or energy hauler does when shot at. 0 is vanilla: it turns and fights. 1: it keeps flying, neither fighting nor fleeing. 2: it flees at once, whatever its morale or shields, and does not drop laser towers on the way out.', $type = 'slidercell', $default = 2, $args = table[$min = 0, $max = 2, $step = 1], $callback = OnMinerBehaviourChanged, ]

table[ $id = 'drjele_xenon_trade_range_jumps', $category = 'Xenon Pressure', $name = 'Miner and hauler range', $mouseover = 'How many gate jumps from where they work Xenon miners and energy haulers will go to mine, buy and sell. 2 is vanilla, and it leaves any Xenon construction farther than that from a mining field or a solar station without supplies. Applied to the ships already flying and, every ten minutes, to the new ones.', $type = 'slidercell', $default = 2, $args = table[$min = 2, $max = 10, $step = 1, $suffix = ' jumps'], $callback = OnTradeRangeChanged, ]

table[ $id = 'drjele_xenon_unstick_impossible_builds', $category = 'Xenon Pressure', $name = 'Unstick impossible builds', $mouseover = 'Xenon station builds that wait for wares the Xenon never make, such as the claytronics and hull parts of a strut of another race the game can end an expansion with: a queued one is cancelled, one already under way is given just those wares. Checked every ten minutes. Off is vanilla, where such a build waits forever.', $type = 'button', $default = 1, $callback = OnUnstickImpossibleBuildsChanged, ]

table[ $id = 'drjele_xenon_pressure_debug', $category = 'Xenon Pressure', $name = 'Debug logging', $mouseover = 'Writes the applied settings and every Xenon shipyard, wharf and invasion evaluation to the debug log. Needs the game started with -debug scripts.', $type = 'button', $default = 0, $callback = OnDebugChanged, ]
